title: Predicting relative human affinity after developability repair

cases.study_information: All molecules are anti-IL-2Rgamma VHHs in the same monovalent VHH-Fc format. The endpoint is the Table 23 human KD divided by the KD of the matched parent in the same CSV. SPR used recombinant human IL-2Rbeta-gamma extracellular-domain reagent P1AE2657, a Biacore 8K at 25 C, VHH-Fc capture on an anti-PGLALA CM3 surface, receptor as analyte and a 1:1 Langmuir fit. The benchmark neutral-pH label is 7.5. KD is in nM; the target ratio is dimensionless. Only parent KD measurements are supplied; variant affinity and cell-binding results are withheld.

output_format: One comma-separated line containing every target exactly once, in the requested order; no explanation.
target_antigen: anti-IL-2Rgamma VHH-Fc; human IL-2Rbeta/gamma-expressing cells; species-matched IL-2Rbeta/gamma ECD for SPR
